open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending confirmation
open_points.text: at most one pending confirmation — its one-time value [...] The confirmation id of an action the owner confirms in it is minted per confirmation, not per session
open_points.question: Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the confirmation id, and is that id minted when the confirmation step is shown or only when the owner successfully confirms the action?
options: The one-time value is the confirmation id, minted when shown
The one-time value and confirmation id are distinct; the confirmation id is minted when confirmation is submitted
The one-time value and confirmation id are distinct; both are minted when shown
open_points.default_guess: Treat them as distinct: mint the one-time value when shown and the confirmation id when the owner submits confirmation.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession last-request instant
open_points.text: changed by the owner's requests (State 2 A13, A16; owner, 2026-10-31): the instant of its last request
open_points.question: Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only product actions, only successful requests, or another stated subset?
options: Every authenticated owner-interface request, including reads and refusals
Every owner product action, including refused attempts, but not reads
open_points.default_guess: Move it on every authenticated request made through the session, including reads and refused requests.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending-confirmation lifecycle
open_points.question: Is a pending confirmation cleared whenever its one-time value is submitted, including when the confirmed action is refused, or only when the action succeeds?
options: Clear on every submission that consumes the one-time value
Clear only when the confirmed action succeeds
Clear on success and on selected refusals
open_points.default_guess: Clear it on every submission that consumes the one-time value, whether the action succeeds or is refused.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession uploaded import file
open_points.text: at most one uploaded import file, replaced by the next upload and dropped when the import is accepted
open_points.question: What product action creates or replaces this session fact, and is the confirmed import action the only action that reads and drops it, rather than the upload being part of a single import request?
options: A separate owner upload action stores or replaces it; confirmed import reads it and drops it on success
The import action itself uploads the file, so no file persists between product actions
A separate upload action stores it, and additional owner actions may read or remove it
open_points.default_guess: Use a separate owner upload action that stores or replaces the file; the confirmed import alone reads it and drops it after acceptance.

open_points.subject: Disclosure of pending confirmation inputs
open_points.text: every agent session fact [...] the owner session, but for its uploaded import file
open_points.question: How is the blanket `business_confidential` classification of all other OwnerSession facts reconciled with a pending import confirmation storing "the inputs it is bound to", when those inputs can include personal-data display names, customer values and object values?
options: Pending confirmation inputs never contain those values and refer only to the uploaded file or non-personal selectors
Each stored confirmation input retains the disclosure class of the underlying fact, so some OwnerSession facts are `personal_data`
All pending confirmation inputs are classified `personal_data` regardless of action
open_points.default_guess: Keep personal values only in the uploaded file; store non-personal selectors or a digest in the pending confirmation so every other OwnerSession fact remains `business_confidential`.
